# Marketing Psychology Skill for Muse

This is a behavioral-science reference skill: Muse identifies which mental models apply to your marketing situation — from foundational thinking tools (first principles, jobs to be done, inversion, Pareto) to buyer-psychology biases (anchoring, loss aversion, social proof, scarcity, endowment effect) — explains the psychology behind each, and gives concrete, ethically-framed marketing applications. Use it to sanity-check pricing, offers, and messaging decisions against how people actually think. Caveat: it's a thinking framework, not a plug-and-play tactic list — you still have to adapt the models to your audience. Discovered via skills.sh. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
